# Vladimir Vishar

> Official personal portfolio of Vladimir Vishar, a realism tattoo artist based in Manchester / Salford, UK, working by appointment at No Regrets Studios Manchester.

## About

- Specialities: colour realism, black-and-grey realism, custom large-scale tattoos, and cover-ups by assessment.
- Current hourly rate: £140/hr.
- Main call to action: "Send your concept."
- Enquiries are handled through the studio, and a consultation takes place before any booking is confirmed.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://vishartattoo.com/): Overview of Vladimir Vishar's realism tattoo work, specialities, and studio location.
- [About](https://vishartattoo.com/about/): Background on the artist and No Regrets Studios Manchester.
- [Colour Realism](https://vishartattoo.com/colour-realism-tattoo-manchester/): Colour realism tattoo work — portraits, wildlife, and floral pieces.
- [Black & Grey Realism](https://vishartattoo.com/black-and-grey-realism-manchester/): Black-and-grey realism tattoo work with dramatic contrast and shading.
- [Cover-Ups](https://vishartattoo.com/cover-up-tattoo-manchester/): Cover-up tattoos, assessed individually before booking.
- [FAQ](https://vishartattoo.com/faq/): Common questions about sessions, preparation, pain, healing, and cover-ups.
- [Aftercare](https://vishartattoo.com/aftercare/): Step-by-step tattoo aftercare and healing guidance.
